edit.description: lift_base folds a file-shaped kind against its governs base, as it already does for path/directory shapes

summary: install lifts each nested CLAUDE.md under its placement id, not the bare stem every one shares
acceptance: install on a tree with several nested CLAUDE.md files writes one module per file with distinct ids, and the first emit regenerates each at its own path
tests: install lifts two nested memory files as two members
notes: Seen by COMMAND-CLAIMS-ITS-NESTED-PLACEMENTS: a file-shaped any-depth kind lifts base-less, so every nested CLAUDE.md lifts as `CLAUDE` and only the module stem is ordinaled.
